facts.fact: Through the StackAdapt–SpotX partnership, StackAdapt advertisers can access premium inventory from more than 600 media owners, including A+E Networks, Discovery, and Pluto TV, via SpotX's CTV network (vendor claim).
facts.quote: Advertisers working with StackAdapt can now access premium inventory from more than 600 media owners

facts.fact: SpotX's CTV network reaches up to 44 million households across the US and Canada (vendor claim).
facts.quote: reaching up to 44 million households across the US and Canada.
